checks: Assignment display survives actual server restart
Delivery display has no further simulation action
Business history follows actual operation order
Changed availability visibly invalidates old proposal
Stale proposal has no approval control or current quote facts
Previously approved stale proposal cannot commit
Reinvestigation produces a fresh proposal for another courier
Fresh proposal still requires a new approval
Fresh approval assigns the replacement courier
Infeasible replay case shows escalation without approval controls
Incident list consistently shows delivered rejected escalated and assigned states
method: Actual isolated Chrome with local replay app. Four synthetic incidents; manual availability mutation and pre-mutation approval are controlled test inputs. No provider key, external HTTP, live quality score or user diagnosis.
